extracted.name: Pizza Pinwheels
extracted.description: These easy pizza pinwheels roll pepperoni and mozzarella in crescent dough for a quick, cheesy party snack served with pizza sauce for dipping.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) can refrigerated crescent roll dough
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Arrange dough triangles on a large baking sheet. Press seams together to form 4 rectangles. Top each rectangle with 6 pepperoni slices; divide mozzarella evenly among rectangles. Roll each rectangle up tightly lengthwise; cut each roll into 4 pieces.
Bake until golden brown, about 12 to 14 minutes. Serve with pizza sauce for dipping.
